series.title: Shikari Shambu
series.style: Classic Indian children's comic-magazine cartoon: bold ink outlines, flat saturated colours, lush green jungle, exaggerated slapstick expressions

Shikari Shambu.marks: a huge cream pith helmet (sola topi) pulled low over his face, with a big bushy moustache underneath that curls up when he feels brave and droops when he is scared
Shikari Shambu.outfit: a green shirt and green shorts, brown boots, an old rifle slung on his back that he never fires, and a camera on a strap round his neck
Shikari Shambu.voice_style: a nervous, squeaky voice that turns boastful when he is praised

Jeeva Jeevantak.age_range: a tall, broad Indian man in his forties
Jeeva Jeevantak.marks: a waxed black moustache and a shiny gold front tooth
Jeeva Jeevantak.outfit: a tan safari suit with many pockets, polished black boots and a big shiny net-gun

places.Chandanpur village square: a dusty village square with a big banyan tree, a stone well, a tea stall and clay-walled houses
places.Sundar Van jungle trail: a lush Indian sal forest with a winding dirt trail, hanging vines, tall trees, birdsong and dappled light
places.The dry waterhole: a wide clearing with a cracked-mud waterhole, a dead tree at its edge; later full of clear water
places.Rani's cave: a shady cave in a rocky hillside with a flat stone ledge where the tigress sleeps
